content:
Elaine: Quick question — PR #3421 updates the migration guide and needs a reviewer. Docs preview job is stuck on linkcheck. Who signs off if the preview keeps failing?
Sam: is the linkcheck flaky or a real failure? any logs? :thinking_face:
ci-bot: docs-preview/job/3421 — status: failed (linkcheck). Logs: https://ci.example.com/3421/logs (timeout on external site)
Kai: sounds like an external timeout. We've seen this before; if it's just a transient 504 on an external link we usually do a manual link check and proceed with reviewer approval.
Maria: what's the standard here for rotation? are we required to wait for green preview before assigning a reviewer from the on-call docs rotation?
Elaine: rotation says wait up to 2 hours, but that blocks the whole merge window for this small clarifying update. It's just a URL to a partner blog that sometimes 403s from CI's IPs.
Jen: I can pick it up and run the preview locally. If local linkcheck passes and it's clearly a flaky external site, I can approve and merge with a note.
Sam: +1 to Jen. also can we add a short fallback process to the rotation doc so on-calls know to escalate flaky external linkchecks? less churn.
Kai: agree — short checklist: 1) try local preview 2) run linkcheck with --skip-external 3) ping eng-infra if it seems IP-blocking 4) reviewer signs off with reason.
Elaine: love that. can someone post the checklist as a brief snippet in #docs so it's discoverable?
Jen: will do. quick commands I run locally:
```
# build docs preview locally
./bin/docs build --preview --pr 3421
# run linkcheck but ignore external domains
./bin/docs linkcheck --ignore-external
```
Jen: if local looks good i'll add a comment on the PR with the manual check results and merge-on-approval.
ci-bot: rerun docs-preview/job/3421 triggered by Jen at 3501240200 — status: still failing (same external timeout).
Maria: ok that confirms it's flaky CI-side. Elaine, is there any org policy preventing manual approval in this case?
Elaine: nope, for docs minor fixes the owner can waive preview if they document the reason. we should still ensure the change is small and not altering security/links to private APIs.
Sam: can we add a one-liner to PR template: "If docs preview fails due to external link timeouts, include local linkcheck output and @docs-rotation who approved."
Elaine: good call. that reduces ambiguity. Jen — when you merge, ping me and I'll add the template tweak.
Jen: merging after approving. I'll leave a comment with the local log and tag @Maria as reviewer backup. :white_check_mark:
docs-bot: PR #3421 — merged by Jen. Change log: migration guide link clarified.
Sam: thanks everyone. I'll put the checklist in a short gist and link it from the docs rotation doc. :thumbsup:
